description: Create digital event invitations with RSVP tracking from your conversation. Save a draft, attach artwork or generate a design, edit event details, manage guests and saved contacts, and view RSVP responses. Publish when ready to share the RSVP page and deliver invitations. Requires a Lemonvite account; publishing and design generation use the account’s available credits or generations.

defaultPrompt: Help me create a Lemonvite invitation draft for my next event.
Show my Lemonvite invitations so I can update event details and manage guests.
Check the RSVPs for my next Lemonvite event and show who is coming.
